name: Direct, triangle-parallel solid voxelization
aliases: GPU Solid Voxelization via Triangle-Parallel YZ Projection
definition: A data-parallel algorithm for solid voxelization that parallelizes over all triangles, dedicating one thread per triangle to determine which voxels inside a closed, watertight object are set.
summary: Direct, triangle-parallel solid voxelization is a GPU algorithm that processes each triangle in parallel to fill a voxel grid, differing from tile-based methods by grouping work per primitive to avoid memory bottlenecks.
